scope: Cold open microscopic patch at measured mid-depth longitudinal speed/compression, hoop stretch, order and nine-contact density. Test releases and holds on matched flowing copies.
preparation: Local constant conditions at the middle gate, sequential supply of centered cold sections, independent lateral sites with periodic hoop lanes. The reference uses all pairs inside a smooth radial cutoff, and harmonic wall contacts on even hoop rows. Finite-offset wall control uses the same nine orientation-averaged Morse bonds. The held displacement is the projection on a stationary localized cosine ripple relative to a live unforced patch. Only that single mode is constrained.
